Commentary.Commentary: So, just the 17 runs needed for Zimbabwe and they should chase it down with ease. Not even a miracle can save Afghanistan. Stay tuned for what could well be the last few moments on this Test.

It was the new ball bowlers who made early inroads and pushed Afghanistan onto the back foot. At one stage, it seemed an innings defeat was on the cards. However, there was a good stand between Zadran and Hamza but Tiripano then played his part, broke that stand and the last two wickets were taken quickly.
End of a fabulous bowling performance from Zimbabwe! They though will be a little disappointed that they let Afghanistan take the lead but it has been a terrific performance from them.

We are back for the final session of Day 2. The Zimbabwe players are out in the middle. Ibrahim Zadran and Abdul Wasi will resume the innings for Afghanistan. Blessing Muzarabani will start the proceedings for this session.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

What a session this is for Zimbabwe! They are on the verge of winning by an innings here with a lead of just over 100. Their opening bowlers were upto the task again as they are the wrecker in chief. Both Victor and Blessing have 3 and 2 wickets each. Williams also played his part with the ball but it is those two who have Afghanistan in huge trouble. A miracle is what Afghanistan need if they are to salvage something out of this game. Join us for what could be the last session of the game in a bit.
